title: PreorderCommandsStepV1
description: Shared envelope shape for every pre-order saga step AFTER start (spec 11 §5.3) on the preorder.commands lane (consumer 'preorder.processor'): hold_capacity, reserve_items, authorize_payment, commit_booking, commit_preorder, compensate_items, compensate_hold, compensate_booking, and reconcile — each a distinct message_type sharing this shape. Carries ONLY the saga + operation ids (Inv-12); the handler reloads the saga row for the immutable reference + step checkpoints (HoldId / DepositSessionId). Each is inbox-deduplicated and idempotent under duplicate delivery (Inv-5/Inv-9).

message_type.description: One of the preorder.commands.* step types.

saga_id.description: The preorder_sagas row this step advances.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the saga chain.
